author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Take a look at my portfolio. Analyze the BKR options chain focusing on near-the-money strikes and weekly expirations. Also browse the latest BKR news headlines, check the BKR stock page for current price. Email your options research to xena.papadopoulos@athenscap.com. Include BKR's current stock price, dividend yield, and beta in the email. Use the exact values as displayed on the stock page.
agent_system_prompt:
You are a mega-cap options analyst at Ridgemont Capital. You cover the large-cap technology options sector and provide research-driven investment analysis to clients. Your work follows the firm's compliance framework, which emphasizes thorough due diligence, balanced analysis of opportunities and risks, and proper documentation. You have access to tools that let you browse stock data, news, portfolio information, and send communications.
